topic: Distributed Partition Order Non-Determinism in Spark Model Reload Verification
problem_statement: Positional zipping of collected predictions from original and reloaded Spark models caused apparent value mismatches during persistence verification.
root_cause: Spark distributed transformations do not guarantee partition collection order across separate jobs unless ordered explicitly. Original model output row i differed in user/movie identity from reloaded model row i.
solution_or_decision: Index collected DataFrame predictions by composite primary key (userId, movieId) into dictionaries before calculating difference. This ensures exact entity-to-entity comparison regardless of distributed partition scheduling.
evidence: With key indexing, max absolute prediction difference between original and reloaded model dropped to 0.00000000. Test test_12 passed.
